method: Independent stdlib/numpy reconstruction from CSV; no research metric/bootstrap/ranking helpers imported
scope: All 15 segment-variant bundles, original-candidate Top1 reranking, pooled metrics and stress diagnostics, paired month-block CIs, nomination/freeze receipts

findings.detail: The training nominee low80 has lower mean net return and PF in both post-training segments, and worse pooled mean/PF. Do not switch to a different later-period winner.
Baseline and each variant have 385 original opportunities and 384 closed trades; the one training entry skip is retained as zero in opportunity mean.
Historical observed-period comparison only, independent trade events, not a portfolio NAV or strict point-in-time/live execution validation.
